AmountOrScalar.description:
Value that can be currency-aware or unitless.

Used for node values that can represent:
- **Amount**: Currency-aware monetary values (e.g., USD 1,000,000)
- **Scalar**: Unitless values (e.g., ratios, percentages, counts)

Covenant.description: Financial covenant specification with test frequency and consequences.

consequences.description: Actions taken if covenant is breached

cure_period_days.description: Optional cure period in days before default

is_active.description: Whether the covenant is currently active

label.description:
Optional instance label disambiguating covenants of the same type.

[`CovenantType::covenant_id`] is discriminant-only, so two covenants of
the same type (e.g. a senior and a total leverage test, or two baskets)
would collide in compliance reports and breach tracking without a
distinct label. Waivers and breaches key off it.

scope.description: Whether the covenant is maintenance or incurrence.

springing_condition.description: Optional activation condition for springing covenants.

test_frequency.description:
How frequently the covenant is tested.

Descriptive metadata only: the engine does **not** enforce this
schedule. Callers control test dates by choosing when to invoke
[`super::CovenantEngine::evaluate`].

CovenantAssessment.description: Evidence for an explicitly selected covenant on one observation date.

effective_threshold.description: Threshold after the active schedule and lender amendments, when applicable.

missing_metric.description: Missing metric identifier when the assessment could not complete.

report.description: Report produced by the engine for an assessed test.

state.description: Applicability and evidence state of the test.

terms.description: Effective terms selected on the observation date when applicable.

CovenantAssessmentState.description: Availability and contractual applicability of an individual test.

oneOf.description: The selected test is outside the effective window or was made inactive.
The lender waived the test without a replacement threshold.
The specified springing condition was assessed and was not met.
The applicable covenant was evaluated on the supplied metric observations.
The test is applicable but required metric evidence is absent.
Mandatory cash sweep of excess cash flow

sweep_percentage.description: Percentage of cash flow to sweep

headroom.description: Cushion relative to threshold (positive => passing buffer)

headroom_raw.description: Signed cushion in the covenant metric's own units when numerically meaningful.

meta.description: Audit stamp: numeric mode, rounding context, and FX policy in force.

CovenantScope.description: Whether a covenant is tested periodically or only upon an action.

oneOf.description: Tested on a schedule (e.g., quarterly leverage tests).
Tested only upon specific actions (e.g., incurrence of debt).

denominator_metric_id.description:
Earnings denominator used to validate a leverage ratio. Required for net
debt/EBITDA, where a negative ratio can mean net cash or negative earnings.
Values must be finite and in the same reporting-period convention as the
ratio. A non-positive denominator makes the test a breach with no headroom.

metric_id.description:
Metric ID to use for evaluation (for financial covenants), conventionally
a statements node ID such as `debt_to_ebitda`, `ebitda`,
`interest_coverage`, or `dscr`.

threshold_schedule.description:
Time-varying threshold schedule that overrides the static threshold in
[`CovenantType`] when present. Enables leverage step-down schedules.

CovenantType.description: Type of financial or operational covenant

oneOf.description: Custom covenant with metric and threshold test
Basket tracking covenant (e.g., available debt baskets)

limit.description: Maximum allowed utilization of the basket

oneOf.description: Minimum debt service coverage ratio (EBITDA / Debt Service)
Maximum net debt to EBITDA ratio (net of cash)

DateWire.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

DecimalWire.description:
Exact decimal encoded only as a JSON string.

Restoration routes through [`crate::decimal::parse_decimal`], the single
exact text-admission rule: JSON numbers, malformed text and inexact values
are rejected rather than rounded. Serialization writes canonical
fixed-point text with trailing zeros removed and signed zero normalized
(`"1.5"`, `"0"`), never scientific notation.

ForecastStream.description:
Replay provenance of one stochastic forecast node in a single run.

The generator is the shared PCG64 started at `state` on stream `stream`
(`Pcg64Rng::new_with_stream(state, stream)`). Both are derived from the
versioned key: the key version, the configured seed, the node and the
single-run mode. Unsigned 64-bit values are decimal strings in JSON.

seed.description: The forecast method's exact configured seed.

stream_version.description: Version of the mapping from the key to the stream.

amount.description:
Monetary amount, carried on the wire as an exact decimal string rather
than a JSON number so no precision is lost in transit. Construction with
configuration applies the selected ingest scale; raw construction does not.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 currency of `amount`. Arithmetic between two `Money` values
requires this to match; there is no implicit conversion.

ObservationCutoff.description:
Which explicit observations an evaluation may read.

On the wire: `"full_snapshot"`, or `{"through": "2025-04-25"}`.

oneOf.description:
Read every observation in the model's snapshot, with no publication
cutoff.

Read an observation only when its availability date is on or before
this date, inclusive through the end of the day.

PeriodId.description:
Identifier for a Gregorian period like `2025Q1` or a fiscal period like
`FY2025W53`.

PositiveF64Wire.description:
Finite JSON number that is strictly greater than zero.

This type is used by serde field adapters so runtime deserialization and
generated schemas enforce the same positive-number contract.

fx_policy_applied.description: Optional FX policy applied by the computing layer (human-readable key).

numeric_mode.description:
Numeric engine mode used to produce the results.

Always [`NUMERIC_MODE_F64`] today; a plain string so result
envelopes stay wire-compatible across host languages.

parallel.description:
Whether the producing computation ran in parallel.

Serial results omit the field entirely so existing payloads and golden
files stay byte-identical.

rounding.description: Rounding context snapshot applied to IO boundaries.

timestamp.description:
Timestamp when result was computed (ISO 8601 format).
Useful for audit trails and reproducibility.

version.description: Finstack Quant library version used to produce the result.

RoundingContext.description:
Snapshot of active rounding settings used for result stamping.

Instances are produced from a [`FinstackConfig`] via `RoundingContext::from` and persisted
alongside valuation results.

ingest_scale_by_currency.description: Validated ingest scale snapshot by currency code, with values in `0..=28`.

mode.description: Explicitly selected rounding mode; absent when none was selected.

output_scale_by_currency.description: Validated output scale snapshot by currency code, with values in `0..=28`.

tolerances.description: Tolerance settings snapshot for floating-point comparisons.

oneOf.description: Nearest; an exact midpoint goes to the even coefficient.

Nearest; an exact midpoint increases absolute magnitude. Other
fractions round to nearest (`1.1` -> `1`), not away from zero.

RunProvenance.description:
What a result was evaluated from.

A consumer that is handed a result checks this against the model, period
plan and run it expects before trusting the cells.

forecast_streams.description:
The random stream of every stochastic forecast node in a single run,
in model node order: enough to replay its draws.

market_content_hash.description:
Canonical snapshot hash of the market held for an explicitly priced run.
Absent if the supplied provider cannot furnish a coherent capture.

model_content_hash.description:
Canonical content hash of the evaluated model
([`FinancialModelSpec::content_hash`](crate::types::FinancialModelSpec::content_hash)).

observation_cutoff.description: Observations the run was allowed to read.

run_id.description:
Identity of this evaluation run: the canonical content hash of the
fields above, including the market snapshot identity when it was supplied.

source_snapshot.description: Identity of the source snapshot the model's observations came from.

valuation_date.description:
Valuation date the capital structure was priced at, when the run used
a market.

SpringingCondition.description: Optional activation condition for springing covenants.

metric_id.description:
Metric that controls activation (e.g., revolver utilization), named by
its statements node ID.

test.description: Threshold test applied to the metric.

StatementCovenantPeriod.description: Covenant results over one verified statement reporting interval.

assessments.description: Individual effective terms, status and reports from the covenant owner.

date.description: Last included day of the stored fiscal or calendar interval.

is_actual.description: Whether observations in this period are historical actuals.

observations.description: Available typed observations by contractual metric identity.

period.description: Stored reporting period selected by the caller.

count.description:
Number of `unit` periods in the tenor. Must be at least 1; `0` is
rejected because a zero-length period makes schedule generation loop.

unit.description:
Calendar unit the count is expressed in, such as days, weeks, months,
or years.

ThresholdSchedule.description:
Piecewise-constant threshold schedule for covenants.

Entries are stored sorted by date ascending. The effective threshold for a
test date is the last entry with date <= test_date. If no entry applies,
[`ThresholdSchedule::threshold_for`] returns `None`.

ThresholdTest.description: Threshold test type (maximum or minimum bound)

generic_epsilon.description:
Epsilon for generic floating-point comparisons (default: 1e-10).

Used for general numerical comparisons where higher tolerance is acceptable.

description: Effective covenant terms and available evidence by dated period.

periods.description: Historical and projected observations in request order.

provenance.description: Run identity of the admitted statement.
